race.comment: WOOTTEN HYDE (7) is the horse to beat after returning with a bang here three weeks ago over this trip first-up. His form around some smart ones adds some substance and with Thompson sticking he can repeat the dose. BOSS MODE (9) was a smart winner when resuming at Doomben and has been good in his next two without striking. Suspect he's at his top now and Maloney can give him a great look from the good draw. CONCESSION (5) was better second-up without threatening at the Gold Coast over this trip. Has further improvement in store third-up and gets in well at the weights with the 3kg claimer taking over. In the mix. IMPERVIOUS (8) was below his best when resuming here last month but is sure to be better for the run and comes firmly into calculations after some key scratchings.
